column1: # Source path -> the case groups that exercise it. First matching row wins for a file; a commit's groups are the union over its changed files
# (git diff --name-only base..candidate, plus the sources of every object file whose stripped bytes differ). `-` means no build input (no workload runs);
# a file no row matches falls back to `smoke` (the smallest cross-area set). Groups are the `groups` of cases.py (dry-perf-gate.sh list).
# A row whose pattern starts with `+` adds its groups to those of the first row that matches the file (the opt-in groups: conc, bgw).
# parallel code first (first match wins): the workers cases are the opt-in group `par`
# --- src/agg: planner and cost (planning cost shows in the first statement and in every read), executor, kernels, leaf readers, parallel
# --- src/col: segment readers/scans, writers, maintenance, build
# --- opt-in groups, added to the rows above
# conc: concurrent backends on state they share (shared dictionaries, leaf cache, lanes, tombstones, free list, visibility, scan and ring of sift_table)
# bgw: the background maintenance workers (requests, backoff, the worker mains, what they run)
